crew.overview: In 1890s India, an arrogant British commander challenges the harshly taxed residents of Champaner to a high-stakes cricket match.
crew.title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India

details.biography:
Terence Lewis is a renowned Indian dancer, choreographer, and actor. He is known for his exceptional talent and contributions to the world of dance in India.

Lewis's journey into dance began in his early years, and he honed his skills through rigorous training in various dance forms, including jazz, ballet, and contemporary dance. He studied at prestigious institutions like the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater and the Martha Graham Center of Contemporary Dance in New York.

He has made significant contributions to the Indian film industry by choreographing iconic dance numbers in films like "Lagaan," "Jhankaar Beats," and "Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela." His choreography is characterized by its fluidity, innovation, and powerful storytelling.
details.name: Terence Lewis
